title: 909. Sort Array By Parity II

examples.explanation: Even indices hold even values and odd indices hold odd values; other valid orders are also accepted.

hints: Even positions need even values and odd positions need odd values; any arrangement meeting that is accepted.
Collect evens and odds separately, then deal them into even and odd slots.
Alternatively sweep two pointers (one on even slots, one on odd slots) swapping misplaced pairs.
